policy: References informed disc and arm proportions, segment and spine layout, and colour placement only. No pixels were sampled, traced, copied or redistributed. Seller imagery was not used as a texture, tracing or proportion source; public seller descriptions guided identity only.
taxonomyNote: The aquarium trade name 'brittle star' covers several reef genera (Ophiocoma, Ophioderma, Ophiomastix and others). The asset is labelled at class/group level (Ophiuroidea) with taxonomyConfidence 'group'; proportions follow the Ophiocoma / Ophioderma group.

referenceGradeRationale: Dorsal (top) photographs of reef Ophiocoma and Ophioderma are openly available and calibrate disc-to-arm ratio, banding and disc granulation; disc and arm sizes come from museum and university accounts. Side and front views of arm cross-sections and spine rows are inferred from anatomical descriptions rather than calibrated images.
